name: sub_0816E570
note: The random-table pointer had to be note-free (no REG_EQUAL, so no REG_EQUIV and no doubled life) to keep r6 with owner in r5. A union built from a zero alignment bit and a 31-bit halfword address does it: combine folds the two field stores into the ldr after cse2, and its masks (1, 0x7FFFFFFF-ish) do not collide with the velocity stores' 0xFFFF/0xFFFF0000 as the u16 halves did. The 1/31 split is also what puts kind in sb over the 0x3FF mask (the other splits tie at 5 refs).
